name: paper-toolkit
description: Deterministic paper writing, checking, composition, and compile tooling with companion `agentsociety-analysis` and `agentsociety-generate-paper` skills.

interface.shortDescription: Write, check, compose, and compile evidence-backed papers.
interface.longDescription: Deterministic academic-paper tooling with companion `agentsociety-analysis` and `agentsociety-generate-paper` Claude Code skills. The toolkit provides CLI commands for templates, evidence graphs, checks, LaTeX composition, compilation, page inspection, figure rendering, literature search, refs dedup, and the analysis pipeline (`paper analysis`), while keeping writing and review judgment in the agent session.
defaultPrompt: Use paper-toolkit to draft an evidence-backed paper section.
Run paper checks and revise the manuscript.
Compile and inspect the current paper workspace.
